newsitem.title: GERMANY: Continental shares up after 9-mo figures.
newsitem.headline: Continental shares up after 9-mo figures.

text.p: Shares in German tyre maker Continental AG rose over four percent in relatively high trading volumes as the company reported a 62 percent jump in pre-tax profit for the first nine months of 1996.

Continental rose 1.15 marks to 26.45 marks in bourse dealings, with almost 200,000 shares traded. In computer trade, Continental was among the day's most heavily traded stocks with almost 600,000 shares changing hands.
Meanwhile the rest of the market was also firmer, with the DAX index of leading shares up 19.69 points to 2,783.78 points by 1117 GMT.
Continental said pre-tax profit was up at 125 million marks and sales were up 2.6 percent to 7.63 billion marks.
The company also said it expects fourth quarter results to match those of the fourth quarter of 1995.
